what: A full-width photo endless slider that changes by sliding sideways. Each slot chases its horizontal position with a spring (mass 2 · tension 70 · friction 26, integrated 1ms at a time). The next slide pushes in from the right while the current one is pushed out to the left (it settles in about 1.5s with no overshoot). It advances on its own every 4s. Dragging makes it follow the hand, and dragging past half the width or flicking fast moves it on. The prev and next buttons, the 03 / 08 counter and the caption change together

options.every: Auto-advance interval (ms), default 0 (no advance) — 4000 in the original
options.scope: Ancestor css (nearest one) to find buttons, numbers and descriptions, default the panel’s parent
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Single photo (multiple) — if data-caption is present, it is used in the caption slot when sliding
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: (optional) prev/next buttons — looked up inside the panel’s parent (or an ancestor found via scope)
options.[data-fx-part=current] · [data-fx-part=t: (If present) Current number / total count (two digits)
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: (if present) the cell that shows the current section’s data-caption
